To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The capacity of the BS-BS link and the BS-RS link have a great impact on the capacity of the system, especially the BS-RS.
the capacity of the system can be improved by increasing the capacity of the link between the BS and RS.
1) The capacity of the RS to MS link has a great influence on the sector throughput.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimal configurations of the two-hop relay down-link system.
the effect on the throughput by choosing different relay positions, resource allocation schemes, BS and RS transmit power.
the optimal configuration of relay system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the optimal configuration of two-hop relay network can be achieved by increasing the average throughput of BS to RS link, deploying RS at the centre of the sector and choosing frequency domain resource allocation.
the optimal position of relay station in the sector is the vertex of the hexagonal sector and the resource allocation scheme in time domain is better than that in frequency domain.
the system performance is improved greatly by the relay technology, and the optimal configuration of the relay system is also discussed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the sector throughput can be greatly improved by choosing the optimal position of the relay station and the appropriate resource allocation scheme, which can be used as a reference for the deployment of relay stations in cellular networks.
the optimal deployment of RS is in the middle of the cell, and the time domain resource allocation scheme is better for sector throughput.
the system throughput is improved significantly by using fixed relay station.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the capacity of BS to RS link is the bottleneck of sector throughput.
the sector throughput can be increased by increasing the average throughput of BS to RS link, and it is critical to optimize the position of RS.
to improve sector throughputs, we should increase the average throughput on the BS to RS links, which means that the BS to RS channel should be as good as possible.
